Text: A disposable agent runtime still needs durable state.

Cloudflare Computer stores the authoritative filesystem state in SQLite within a Durable Object. Its container backend exposes that state through a FUSE-mounted filesystem inside a sandbox container, where the agent can run standard Linux tools. Filesystem changes are synchronized back to the Durable Object over RPC.
